text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy the race, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It looked like everyone in the stands was having fun too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Their sparkling eyes and cheering voices mean more than anything to me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: After all, I was only able to win today because of their support!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You know what? I want to do something for them as thanks!
choice_data_list: You've already gifted them with a fantastic victory!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha! You flatter me. ♪ You say that as if that's the greatest gift of all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But thank you! That means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's time to make our triumphant return together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The track is my stage, and I still have so many more races to perform on it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Each time I step up on that stage, I'll give everyone the time of their lives—and that's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you to keep up the tough love during training!
